uncited: - Parameter File (`map.ini.c`): A text file where each line contains a numbered parameter, followed by at least one whitespace character, then the value.
Comments start with an asterisk (`*`) as the first non-whitespace character on a line.
Everything after a parameter on the same line is ignored.
**Grid Construction**: Construct the target rectangular grid.
- Users may specify bounding $i, j, k$ values to carve out sections for zooming.
**Filtering**: Apply a filtering function to map the scattered data onto the rectangular grid.
